description: This is a unit test class for the ConnectionDeleted class, testing its equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, resource path, and constructor null checks.

classes.name: ConnectionDeletedTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ConnectionDeleted class, verifying equality, immutability, JSON (de)serialization, resource path, and constructor null argument handling.
